scripts.zip: npm run zip:flock && npm run zip:ysatools
scripts.zip:flock: npm run build:flock && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist/flock/* -DestinationPath dist/flock.zip -Force"
scripts.zip:ysatools: npm run build:ysatools && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist/ysatools/* -DestinationPath dist/ysatools.zip -Force"
